purpose: Manuscript extraction and vector rendering of existing same-task measurements; no experiment rerun.
hardware_limitations: The frozen protocol records x86_64 Linux and 62 visible CPUs, not processor model, clock, RAM capacity, affinity, or competing load. No current-machine specification is substituted.

primary_protocol.cpu_unit: child user plus system seconds from wait4
primary_protocol.isolation: Fresh Linux fork, preloaded imports, sequential jobs, child CPU/RSS via wait4; wall cap includes serialization and all child work
primary_protocol.timing_scope: Imports and fixture construction excluded; existing solver internal verification included; independent original-tree witness verification outside child timing
primary_protocol.method_order: Repetition outermost; cases in registered order; rotate method list by (case_index + repetition) modulo method count; reverse if floor(case_index/method_count)+repetition is odd

plot_methods: Current structural prototype versus original-edge support enumeration. The older structural prototype remains in the appendix completion table and all raw measurements.
plot_timeout_policy: A categorical top/right margin preserves every timeout; no CPU-time value is assigned to a timeout and no follow-up time enters the figure.

development_not_confirmation.scope: These 30 inputs informed equality-reduction engineering; they are not additional out-of-sample confirmation inputs.

posthoc_correctness_only.independent_replay_scope: Read-only artifact integrity and exact-distance feasibility replay. Enumeration answer agreement is a software cross-check, not formal independent proof of each minimum or NO.

binary_reduction_controls.logic: Independent closed source minimum plus independently replayed strict witnesses bounds the strict source minimum.
binary_reduction_controls.limits: 12 base inputs plus two deterministic rescalings, not 14 independent inputs. Closed lower bounds are combined with separate strict witnesses; no timing comparison or finite proof of hardness.

scientific_scope: Exact minimum strict source count within a budget on small synthetic trees; no biological recovery, empirical coverage, published-software comparison, or universal speed claim.

new_work.work_performed: Read saved JSON/JSONL, reconcile records, aggregate recorded CPU values, and render graphics.
